about: Flats of the cabin's panels (tools/recon/osa/panel_flats.py): which picture, which picked edge chains bound the plate, what gives its size. Numbers only; the pictures stay in out/recon (wwp_gecko is copyrighted).

flats.what: the dashboard's plane: the instrument plate and, in the same plane to its right, the switch plate
flats.scale_basis: the instrument plate is 445 mm wide if its instruments are of their usual classes: the three small gauges' bezels then measure 68 mm (the 60 mm class of Soviet lorry instruments), the tachometer's 83 mm (the 80 mm class), the speedometer's 122 mm. No drawing gives the plate's size: good to about 3 %

flats.what: the dashboard's plane seen in g084-c: the plate behind the steering wheel, left of the instrument plate, and what the wheel hides in the other views

flats.scale_basis: mon_2112_80 Fig. 3 draws PU-303 0.31 m wide in plan (about 4.7 mm per pixel: good to 10 mm); a drawing, so its proportions are as drawn
